validation_errors.message: "Giulio Tononi's article develops an information integration theory of consciousness. It argues that consciousness requires both differentiation and integration, proposes Φ as a measure of integrated causal information, and uses this framework to explain why thalamocortical networks support consciousness while modular or merely input-output systems often do not.
